topics.label: Lecture Introduction and the Hallmarks of Cancer Framework
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic establishes the lecture's learning objectives and introduces the foundational framework of cancer hallmarks and multistep tumor progression.

topics.label: Growth Signal Autonomy and Deregulated Signaling Cascades
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how mutations in cell surface receptors and intracellular signaling pathways allow cancer cells to sustain proliferative signaling and resist growth inhibition.

topics.label: Differentiation Block in Tumorigenesis
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore how cancer cells disrupt lineage maturation and terminal differentiation in both hematopoietic malignancies and colonic epithelium.

topics.label: Evasion of Apoptosis
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic details how tumor cells avoid programmed cell death through alterations in p53 regulation and the balance of pro- and anti-apoptotic mitochondrial proteins.

topics.label: Replicative Immortality and Cellular Senescence
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe how cancer cells bypass the Hayflick limit and normal senescence barriers through telomerase activation and altered stress-response signaling.

topics.label: Cancer Metabolic Rewiring and the Warburg Effect
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics introduce complex hallmarks and examine how cancer cells rewire metabolic pathways toward aerobic glycolysis and altered Krebs cycle activity.

topics.label: Induction of Tumor Angiogenesis
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe the necessity, progression timing, and molecular balance governing new blood vessel formation to support tumor growth.

topics.label: Mechanisms and Inefficiencies of Metastasis
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic examines the biological steps, anatomical constraints, diagnostic markers, and genomic features underlying metastatic dissemination.

topics.label: Conclusion and Final Summary
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture with summarizing remarks on cancer hallmark complexity and housekeeping for upcoming sessions.
